name: walkerhughes
description: Claude ecosystem tooling: MCP servers, plugins, and configuration.

plugins.name: fred
plugins.description: Economic data from the St. Louis Fed's FRED API: search 800,000 series, pull several at once onto one date index with transformations like year-over-year applied server-side, see what a number was first reported as before revision, and check the release calendar.

plugins.name: harbor-hub
plugins.description: Inspect Harbor hub evaluation jobs, trials, and uploads from Claude Code, and publish tasks, datasets, and job archives when writes are enabled.

plugins.name: persona
plugins.description: Write in your own voice. Ships a plain-language style skill, plus a local labeling loop that learns your voice from your own transcripts and builds a translation skill from it. Everything stays on your machine.

plugins.name: tastytrade
plugins.description: Inspect TastyTrade brokerage accounts, positions, market data, option chains, and transactions from Claude Code. Order placement is gated off by default.
